title: AI Fantasy: We Made a Text RPG with Everything Pre-Generated by AI: Quests, Images, Gameplay Stats, Music
author: Flimsy-Tea-7230

comments.author: Flimsy-Tea-7230
comments.body:
Hello!

Everything in our game AI Fantasy was generated by AI. The idea was to harness the power of AI to generate a quantity of content that wouldn't be possible otherwise. The game features 100 unique stories, over 10,000 events, and several thousand items. This massive amount of content was only possible by pre-generating it with LLMs and image generation tools.

We think that having things pre-generated instead of being generated on demand is an interesting use of AI, with a lot of potential to be explored in game development and design.

The demo is on Steam Next, and the game releases on November 1st! Feel free to download, play the game, and wishlist it!
